text: Ko onon yo yimɓe am, ɗaɓɓiree Alla haforanal, refti tuubanon Mo junuubi mon ɗin, ɓuri mawnude e majji ko sirku. O yoɓitiray on ɗum jippingol toɓo ɗuuɗungo, O ɓeyda on teddungal e hoore teddungal mon ngal ɗuuɗireede ɓiɗɓe e jawle. Wata on ɗuurno e ko mi noddata on kon, laatoron ngol ɗuurngal mon ɗon bomɓe e yedduɓe Alla fennuɓe ko mi addi kon.
